release_notes:
Fix custom fields disappearing after syncing some services

A recent fix for duplicate serial-number boxes on reconnected services
was too broad: if a supplier's current service list didn't include
field requirements for a service (which can happen even when the
service genuinely needs one), syncing that service's custom fields
would remove the field entirely instead of leaving it alone, leaving
the order form with no input at all. The cleanup now only runs when
we've actually confirmed a replacement field from the supplier, so an
incomplete response can no longer wipe a field with nothing to show
for it.
